name: eevee-bowl-holder
description: eevee bowl holder — written by the Forge Assistant. Replace this line with what the part is for, what it fits, and anything it has to clear.

part.description: Which piece to build: 0 the base, 1 an ear, 2 the tail

bowl_diameter.description: Rim diameter of the stainless bowl that drops in

bowl_height.description: Height of the bowl from its base to its rim

fit_clearance.description: Gap between the bowl rim and the bore, all the way round

bowl_lift.description: Air under the bowl's base once it is seated

rim_capture.description: Plain wall standing above the seat, around the bowl rim

lip_width.description: How far the seat ledge reaches in under the bowl rim

foot_height.description: Height of the arcaded base zone

feet_count.description: Number of piers around the arcaded base

collar_leaves.description: How many leaves in the fur collar

collar_length.description: Root-to-tip length of one collar leaf

collar_overlap.description: How much each leaf overlaps its neighbour, as a fraction of the pitch

collar_droop.description: How far the leaves lean out from vertical. 42-48 deg is the window where the leaf tips are support-free as well as their undersides

collar_jitter.description: Per-leaf variation, so the collar reads as fur and not as a machined ring

collar_seed.description: Change it for a different collar; the same number always builds the same one

ear_length.description: Root to tip of an ear, not counting its peg

ear_width.description: Width of an ear at its widest

tail_length.description: Root to tip of the tail

tail_width.description: Width of the tail at its widest

appendage_thickness.description: Blade thickness of the ears and the tail; must bury the peg

appendage_rounding.description: Fillet on the top edge of an ear or tail; stepped down if the kernel refuses it

peg_diameter.description: Peg on the appendages, and the socket in the base rim

peg_length.description: How far a peg goes into its socket
